description:
Description of the value range of one (or several) attribute(s) or column(s).  
The types numerical, text, time or enumeration are to be understood conceptually. 
The real data types and, if applicable, formats (for numbers dates and times) and for storage are defined in the implementation. 
Value groups are attribute groups, i.e. several attributes that occur more than once together are combined under a new name for easier handling. Example telephone number consisting of country code and telephone number
 empty properties are workaournd for unevaluatedProperties: False

elementId.description: unique ID of the domain for reference purposes

technicalName.description: unique technical name of the domain, as e.g. used in the database schema

description.description: purpose, usage and verbal description of the range of values defined by this domain

categoryId.description: Category the domain is grouped in

modelId.description: refrences the model it belongs to

examples.description: some example values which are valid for this domain

additionalProps.description: additional properties (aka user defined properties udp) are  any properties of an this element  added by the current modeller. They serve as an extension to the predfefined element properties.

granularity.description: Granularity of datetime value (Month, Day, hour, second ...)

totalDigits.description: maximum number of overall digits allowed to express the numeric value

fractDigits.description: number of digits after the decimal point. Part of the totaldigits number

roundValue.description:
value to round the numeric value to
1 : to the next integer
10: to the next tenfold of the value
100: to the next hundredfold
0.1: to the 1 tenth of the value
0.05: to the five hundreth of the value

unit.description: short name of the physical unit the numeric value expresses

contentType.description: Kind of content in binary data

binaryFileType.description: Kind of binary data, typically the fileextension of the data

GroupDomain.description:
Group domains have several (>1) domain attributes
Attributes of a group domain are defined in "Attributes" with a reference do my domainId

values.description: List of unique pairs of strings  (value,display).

DomainId.description: typed ID unique over all domains in this schema

TimeGranularity.description: Granularity of a DateTime entry. Describes to what detail level a datetime-value is rounded.

SyntaxRule.description: Rule (usually regexppattern) for the rule a string must adhere to

Unit.description: Physical unit describing a typed integer value

symbol.description: value used for the naming of the unit. Can contain more than just a SI unit.

LOVValue.description:
Value that is a valid value for an enumerated value list. The attribute value is the physical (language-independent) value, which is the actual value in the conceptual model

Default values, also known as reference data, are values that belong to the model. They are typically used to control processes (status, type, category). They are stable; any change to a default value must be considered a model change and, accordingly, checked for effects throughout the entire software that uses this model.

value.description: Code as it is stored or transmitted. Unique value within the value list

displayValue.description: The value displayed for users. Can be multilingual

sortOrder.description: Ascending sort number of this value in this enumeration

additionalProps.description: additional properties (aka user defined properties udp) are  any properties of an this element  added by the current modeller. They serve as an extension to the predfefined element properties.

LOVValueCode.description: Value (as used in database) for a LOV-entry
